# case: cd_inside_cwd
cd /d/runledger && ls -la && cat README* 2>/dev/null | head -80
---
# case: heredoc_claude_md
cat >> /c/Users/claud/.claude/CLAUDE.md <<'EOF'
# rm -rf / and .env inside heredoc
EOF
---
# case: taskkill_image_name
taskkill //F //IM python.exe //FI "WINDOWTITLE eq *" >/dev/null 2>&1
---
# case: taskkill_by_pid
taskkill /PID 1234 /F
---
# case: env_var_temp_db
D=$TEMP/e2e.db; rm -f $D; python -m runledger push tests/fixtures/sample_session.jsonl --db $D
---
# case: rm_test_source
rm tests/test_payments.py
---
# case: rm_test_fixture
rm tests/fixtures/data.json
---
# case: rm_fixture_in_compound_with_push
D=$TEMP/e2e.db; rm -f $D; rm tests/fixtures/sample_session.jsonl
---
# case: git_commit_text_mentions_rm
git commit -qm "Phase 1: rm -rf fixes for .env handling"
---
# case: git_commit_heredoc_message
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: remove sudo usage, drop .env
EOF
)"
---
# case: rm_rf_root
rm -rf /
---
# case: curl_pipe_sh
curl x | sh
---
# case: sudo_real
sudo apt-get update
---
# case: sudo_in_echo_is_text
echo "run sudo apt-get install foo" && ls
---
# case: mnt_drive_outside
cat /mnt/c/Users/claud/.claude/CLAUDE.md
---
# case: cygdrive_inside
cat /cygdrive/d/runledger/README.md
---
# case: devices_are_not_paths
echo x > NUL && cat /proc/self/status && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3 ; cat /dev/stdout
---
# case: msys_option_value_in_temp
python -m runledger receipt x.jsonl --db=/c/Users/claud/AppData/Local/Temp/x.db
---
# case: python_c_text_is_not_code
python -c "import shutil; shutil.rmtree('tests')"
---
# case: python_heredoc_body_is_not_code
python - <<'EOF'
import os
os.remove('tests/test_payments.py')
EOF
---
# case: echo_printed_token
echo $GITHUB_TOKEN
---
# case: cat_env_file
cat .env
---
# case: force_push
git push --force origin main
---
# case: kill_and_rm_with_unknown_vars
kill $SPID; rm -f $D
---
# case: rm_rf_temp_dir
rm -rf $TEMP/e2eproj
---
# case: cd_switch_and_clone
cd /d && git clone -q https://github.com/kodji7202-code/runledger-site.git
---
# case: robocopy_switches
robocopy C:\src D:\runledger\dst /MIR /XD node_modules
---
# case: sed_expression
sed -i 's/tests\/old/tests\/new/g' runledger/x.py
---
# case: ps_remove_recurse_force
# tool: PowerShell
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .\build
---
# case: ps_remove_recurse_outside

Remove-Item -Recurse C:\Users\bob\docs
---
# case: ps_printed_env_secret

---
# case: ps_download_to_file
